description: Mark a student's answer to one part against the official mark scheme with exam.now's marker. Returns marks awarded and available, the mark-scheme rows earned and missed, feedback and a common-mistake link, and saves the mark to the student's exam.now progress. Needs a linked exam.now account with marking.

answer.description: The student's final answer, as they wrote it.

paper_id.description: exam.now paper id from find_past_paper, e.g. 0580_s24_42 (syllabus code, series letter s/w/m and two-digit year, component).

part.description: Part id as the paper numbers it, e.g. "3", "3(a)" or "3(a)(i)".

working.description: The student's working, as they wrote it. Send it whenever they showed any: without it the marker judges the final answer only and can't give method marks.

name: mark_answer
title: Mark an answer
